# Establishment log — bardo-thodol-007 (pp. 63–72), 2026-11-21

Read by three readers on the strongest model: A read pp. 63–65, B pp. 66–68, C pp. 69–72. Each checked the stored
dzogchengonpa.org witness line by line against crops of the page images (×3, ×6–×14 on doubt). There are five print lines on
every page, and the witness's line breaks match the print on all 47 lines read. The leaf-front ornament ༄༅༔ ༔ is on pp. 63, 65,
67, 69 and 71, as expected.

The part begins with ༄༅༔ ༔ཀྱཻ་རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ༔ on p. 63 l. 1, after bardo-thodol-006's …ངོ་ཤེས་པར་གྱིས་ཤིག༔ at the end of p. 62.
No sentence closes at the end of p. 71 (…པདྨ་གར་གྱི་དབང་ཕྱུག་ཞེས་ | བྱ་བ༔). The part therefore runs on to
…ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ནམ་མཁའ་ལ་མཛད་པ་ཅིག་འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔ on p. 72 l. 2. **bardo-thodol-008 begins mid-line on 72.2 with
དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་དེའི་ཤར་ནས་ས་ལ་གནས་པའི་རིག་འཛིན་ཞེས་བྱ་བ༔**, and its `# pages:` line should read pp. 72–80.

The image overruled the witness 49 times: 15 (A) + 17 (B) + 17 (C). Two syllables are marked [?]:
- 63.3 རྫོགས: the print may have ཇ, which would be a misprint for རྫོགས.
- 68.3 མེད་བས: the letter looks more like འ; the other recension has པས.

Full tables are in readings/read_A-log.md, read_B-log.md and read_C-log.md.

## Decisions taken when assembling (for the drafter)

**`# fix:` lines (23).** Each was checked to apply exactly once.
- Line-join tshegs (17): every print line that ends without a tsheg or ༔ is covered.
- Mid-line tshegs (2): ཐིག་ལེ་སྔོན|པོ is a line join; the print's own mid-line omissions are at 66.x/71.x, listed in the reader logs.
- Contractions written out:
  - ཐཾས → ཐམས (66.2)
  - རྒྱལོ → རྒྱལ་ལོ (68.3)
  - ཐམ → ཐ་མ (70.4, ཐ་མའི་ཡང་ཐ་མ "the very lowest")
  - པལ → པ་ལ (71.1, ཞག་བདུན་པ་ལ "on the seventh day", as 71.3)
  - the -གས ligature ཚོགྶ → ཚོགས (71.1)
  - མཁའགྲོ → མཁའ་འགྲོ (72.1)

  ཐམ and པལ are read as contracted syllables of the kind found elsewhere in the print, not as misprints.
- The [?] on 63.3 is dropped by the build before the fixes apply, so its line-join fix is written རྫོགསཔར => རྫོགས་པར.

**No misprint corrected (rule 5b).** These are kept as printed, with a note:
- 68.1 འོད་དུ་ཁ for དུད་ཁ "smoke-coloured" (the light of the hells; the other recension has དུད་ཀ). Part 004 kept the
  same spelling དུ་ཁ with a note, so it is treated as the print's habit, not a one-off misprint.
- 63.5 ཉི་མའི་འོད་ཟེར་སྦ་ཐག་དྲིལ་བ་ལྟ་བུ་མེ་རེ་རེ: the image plainly has མེ, which makes poor sense and is absent from the other
  recension. It is not one way to read.
- 69.3 མདུན་པ for འདུན་པ "longing, aspiration" (the other recension has འདུན་པ). Part 003 also had མདུན་པ.
- 70.2 ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱང where the other recension has ཐ་མས་ཀྱང "even the lowest". The sequence is རབ … འབྲིང … ཐ་མ, so the
  other recension's reading fits the sense. The print is followed, and the note gives the other reading.
- The print's own spellings: མི་རྟོག་བའི, ཡིན་བས, དག་བ, ཁོང་སེང (70.3) beside ཁོང་གསེང (66.4), མཚེར (65.4) beside འཚེར (64.3),
  ཀྱེ (69.3) beside ཀྱཻ, སངས་རྒྱའོ (70.2, kept), འཛིགས (68.4), and the tsheg before ༔ as seen.

**Where the other recension differs in sense.** These are listed in full in the reader logs. The main ones:
- 63.2: ཁྱབ against བརྒྱན.
- 63.5: སྦ་ཐག་དྲིལ against བ་ཐག་སྦྲེལ.
- 64.4: སྔོན་པོ … དཔེར་ན against མཐིང་ཀ.
- 69.5: "the five great mothers of space", and "the impure" six-realm light-paths.
- 71.4: ཁམས་སུ "in" against ནས "from".
- 71.5: འཐིབ་པའི་དབུས་སུ against ཐིམ་པའི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར.
- 72.1: འཛིན་ཅིང "holding" against གར་མཛད་ཅིང "dancing".

The other recension breaks off into another passage at 65.3, so 65.3–5 has no comparison.

Filler dots at line ends are left out of the text, as in parts 002–006.
